description: The line plot, titled "Performance w.r.t. Temperature," illustrates the relationship between accuracy (measured as Pass@8) and temperature for three different methods: On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT. The x-axis, labeled "Temperature," spans from 0.1 to 1.0 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)," ranges from 62.5 to 80.0, also on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 2.5. The plot displays three distinct lines: On-policy RL is represented by a yellow line with triangle markers, LUFFY by a red line with star markers, and SFT by a teal line with inverted triangle markers. The On-policy RL line starts at a low accuracy of approximately 64.0 at a temperature of 0.1 and generally trends upward, peaking at around 75.0 at a temperature of 0.8 before declining to about 73.5 at 1.0. The LUFFY line begins at a high accuracy of approximately 75.5 at a temperature of 0.1, fluctuates with several peaks and troughs, and ends at a high accuracy of 80.0 at a temperature of 1.0. The SFT line starts at an accuracy of about 75.5 at a temperature of 0.1, decreases to a low of approximately 66.0 at a temperature of 0.5, then rises to a peak of about 76.5 at a temperature of 0.6, and finally declines to around 74.5 at a temperature of 1.0.
